mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings growth prospects, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when GDPC1 growth decelerates, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an increase in the federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
